sections.title: From the Uncanny to Horror: Film and Psychoanalysis
sections.description: This course introduces students to the links between psychoanalysis and film by focusing on two themes, the Uncanny and Horror. See the English Department's website at www.english.upenn.edu for a description of the current offerings.
